# W49 BFloat16 fixture provenance

This synthetic public fixture was generated by `/Users/sergey/.local/bin/clickhouse` reporting exactly `ClickHouse local version 26.7.1.1315 (official build).` The generator is `scripts/generate_public_wide_bfloat16_w49_fixture.sh`.

The producer is a local MergeTree table with sorted UInt64 key `pk` and exact scalar, nullable scalar, Array, and Array(Nullable) BFloat16 columns. It uses Wide parts, `CODEC(LZ4)`, plain adaptive `.mrk2` marks, `index_granularity = 2`, and no custom serialization overrides. Seven synthetic keys form mark rows `[2, 2, 2, 1]` plus the EOF sentinel.

Values are made from binary32 patterns with zero low halves before conversion to BFloat16. This preserves the intended BFloat16 raw bits, including positive and negative zero, subnormals, infinities, two distinct NaN payloads, empty arrays, all-NULL arrays, and NULL slots between non-NULL values. The fixture contains no user table data. ClickHouse stores a physical two-byte child slot for each nullable-array NULL; RowBinary emits only its NULL flag for that slot.

`SHA256SUMS` records the generated part files. Recreate only when the destination is absent, then compare the manifest.
